explanation.en:
You can turn an い-adjective into an adverb by changing the final い to く. This allows the adjective to modify a verb.

Key points:
• い → く makes an adverb
• Adverbs describe how an action is done
• Works for all い-adjectives
• Example: 早い → 早く (quickly)

For example, “早く起きます” means “I wake up early.” “ゆっくり” is already an adverb, but many adverbs are made from い-adjectives.

Another example: “おいしい” becomes “おいしく,” and you can say “おいしく食べます” (I eat deliciously).

This pattern is very useful for adding detail to actions. Once you know an い-adjective, you can easily make an adverb and use it with verbs.

Practice: 大きい → 大きく, 速い → 速く, 安い → 安く.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using い-adjective directly with a verb
commonMistakes.example: ❌ 早い起きます → ✅ 早く起きます

commonMistakes.mistake: Adding な to make an adverb
commonMistakes.example: ❌ 安いな買います → ✅ 安く買います
